feat: replace runc exec with process manager (#1422)
<! This is an auto-generated description by cubic. >
## Summary by cubic
Replaced runc-based sandbox exec with a lightweight in-container process
manager (goproc) for more reliable execs and simpler lifecycle handling.
Sandbox containers now start goproc as PID 1 and expose a control port
for exec requests.
- **Refactors**
- Set goproc as the entrypoint for sandbox stubs and bind-mount it at
/usr/bin/goproc.
- Expose sandbox process manager port 7111 and create a goproc client
per container.
- Route RunCSandboxExec through goproc.Exec; remove runc exec and
in-process IO/state tracking.
- Remove legacy sandbox helpers and update instance/types with process
manager fields and constants.
- No changes required to sandbox images; the worker injects the binary.
- **Dependencies**
- Add github.com/beam-cloud/goproc v0.1.2 and install goproc binaries
(v0.1.1) for amd64/arm64 in the worker image.
<! End of auto-generated description by cubic. >
-
Co-authored-by: Luke Lombardi <luke@beam.cloud>

fix: correctly pass tcp-close (#1420)
<! This is an auto-generated description by cubic. >
## Summary by cubic
Fixes restore behavior by correctly passing tcp-close to runc so CRIU
closes TCP connections during restore. Prevents dangling sockets and
improves reliability of NVIDIA container restores.
- **Bug Fixes**
- Move TCPClose from CheckpointOpts to RestoreOpts to ensure runc
receives tcp-close on restore.
- **Dependencies**
- Bump github.com/beam-cloud/go-runc to
v0.0.0-20250911154456-bb45084abfe1.
- Pin worker runc to commit d85a780 on dlm/force-compat-mode-on-restore.
<! End of auto-generated description by cubic. >
Co-authored-by: Luke Lombardi <luke@beam.cloud>

fix: improve c/r network logic (#1414)
<! This is an auto-generated description by cubic. >
## Summary by cubic
Improves checkpoint/restore networking and TCP handling to reduce
restore failures and IP conflicts. Also removes Redis-backed checkpoint
state and related APIs for a simpler flow.
- **Bug Fixes**
- Networking: always pick the next free IP in the container subnet; log
the assigned IP.
 - CRIU: disable AllowOpenTCP and enable TCPClose during restore.
 - Restore only when checkpoint status is "available".
 - Sandbox: detach exec and use tini as PID1 to handle signals/zombies.
- **Refactors**
- Remove Redis checkpoint state storage and the related
proto/service/SDK types.
 - Update types.NullTime to {time, valid}.
 - Bump go-runc and runc commits; add wget to worker image.
<! End of auto-generated description by cubic. >
-
Co-authored-by: Luke Lombardi <luke@beam.cloud>

fix: local criu support for development (#1395)
<! This is an auto-generated description by cubic. >
## Summary by cubic
Enables local CRIU checkpoint/restore in development on both x86_64 and
ARM64. Simplifies config to use local storage and makes workers fail
fast on task queue errors.
- **New Features**
- Build CRIU in the worker image for x86_64 and ARM64; skip GPU plugins
on ARM64 and only verify the CUDA plugin on x86_64.
- Enable CRIU by default; set checkpointPath to /data/checkpoints and
use local storage.
- **Bug Fixes**
- Exit the runner on unexpected task queue errors to avoid stuck
workers.
<! End of auto-generated description by cubic. >
-
Co-authored-by: Luke Lombardi <luke@beam.cloud>

feat: add helm var to support RBAC for deploying workspaces in extra namespaces (#19517)
This is a feature to create Role & RoleBinding entries on a per
namespace basis to support deploying workspaces in separate namespace to
where Coder is deployed. The idea behind this is to avoid the creation
of custom RBAC entries or the use of ClusterRoles (in order to maintain
priciple of least privilege).
> If you have used AI to produce some or all of this PR, please ensure
you have read our [AI Contribution
guidelines](https://coder.com/docs/about/contributing/AI_CONTRIBUTING)
before submitting.
This is a blink assisted PR.

- Terraform project analysis and management services
- Configuration handling and default settings
- Logging and utility modules
- Example Terraform project with multi-environment support
- Release and build scripts
- Rust toolchain configuration
Key additions:
- Implemented stdio-based MCP server transport
- Added Terraform configuration parsing and analysis
- Created modular project structure with shared utilities
- Included comprehensive example Terraform project
- Added build and release automation scripts
